<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 290" width="520" height="290">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="dots" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="0.9" fill="#000000"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="520" height="290" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="160" y="130" width="240" height="50" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="172" y="132" width="226" height="46" fill="url(#dots)"/>
  <rect x="166" y="130" width="6" height="50" fill="#666666" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <rect x="400" y="145" width="32" height="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="432" y="138" width="8" height="34" fill="#808080" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="166" y1="155" x2="96" y2="155" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="155" x2="92" y2="155" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="100,155 91,151 91,159" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="160" x2="30" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="166" y1="130" x2="166" y2="62" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="416" y1="165" x2="416" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="436" y1="138" x2="436" y2="104" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="166" cy="155" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="436" cy="155" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <text x="50" y="146" text-anchor="start">5.0 N</text>
    <text x="30" y="250" text-anchor="start">trigger</text>
    <text x="166" y="54" text-anchor="start">piston, area 2.0 cm<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">2</tspan></text>
    <text x="440" y="252" text-anchor="end">nozzle, area 0.080 cm<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">2</tspan></text>
    <text x="436" y="94" text-anchor="middle">stopper</text>
    <text x="260" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 5.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
